race.comment: HELLAVALEGACY (8) sets the standard after resuming with a strong second at Toowoomba, beaten just over half a length by Mean Mahal on heavy ground. She was only an outside chance in betting there, so the run had substance, and the 2kg claim helps her second-up profile. MISS D'MEZ (13) is harder to sell on raw finishing positions, having been unwanted in betting at Ipswich and Sunshine Coast, but she is third-up, race fit and gets a chance in a race without much exposed depth. ZOUBUCA SHOTS (10) has the most consistent recent profile, placed three times from six starts in the past 12 months and fourth as favourite at this track last start. Include in multiples. SHE'S OUR VEGA (12) brings no race form, but the close third in her latest Gold Coast trial, 3kg claim and a trainer with a strong debut record give her enough readiness to be treated as a genuine first-start danger. Keep an eye on the betting with her as well as RUNNING ON EMPTY (3) who is also on debut.
